definitions.explanation: The point beyond which something cannot go.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}の{限界|げんかい}に{達|たっ}した。
examples.english: I reached the limit of my physical strength.

examples.japanese: {我慢|がまん}にも{限界|げんかい}がある。

notes:
{限界|げんかい} refers to limits and boundaries.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {限界|げんかい}がある (there is a limit)
- {限界|げんかい}に{達|たっ}する (to reach the limit)
- {限界|げんかい}を{超|こ}える (to exceed the limit)
- {限界|げんかい}を{感|かん}じる (to feel one's limits)
